zh: 保留的后缀一旦确定，执行过程就是确定的：按顺序把程序塞进当前时隙，塞不下就开新时隙。关键看所需时隙数随删除的前缀变多是否单调。
删掉更多前缀不会让所需时隙数增加，所以“可行的起点”构成一个后缀区间，可以对起点二分。
写 valid(start)：slots=1、used=0，依次处理 time[i]：若 used+time[i]>k 则 slots 加 1、used 清零，再 used+=time[i]；slots>m 时返回不可行。二分出最小的可行起点 lo（lo=n 表示空后缀），输出 n−lo。
en: Once the kept suffix is fixed, execution is deterministic: put programs into the current slot in order and open a new slot when one does not fit. The key question is whether the number of slots is monotone as more of the prefix is deleted.
Deleting more of the prefix never increases the number of slots needed, so the feasible starts form a suffix of positions and you can binary search the start.

Write valid(start): slots = 1, used = 0; for each time[i]: if used + time[i] > k, slots += 1 and used = 0; then used += time[i]; return false once slots > m. Binary search the smallest feasible start lo (lo = n means the empty suffix) and print n - lo.

explanationEn:
## Approach

Binary search the start of the suffix, counting the slots needed with the left-to-right procedure the problem defines. Deleting more of the prefix never increases the minimum number of slots.

## Proof of correctness

For a fixed start, the greedy that fills the current slot as much as possible ends its first segment no earlier than any other valid segmentation; by induction over segments it uses the minimum number of segments. After deleting a prefix, the remaining segments of a valid segmentation can still be used, and the greedy only uses fewer, so feasible starts are monotone (they form a suffix); binary search finds the earliest feasible start, which gives the longest program suffix.

## Complexity

Time O(n log n), space O(n).
